records.rationale: In apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts the handler decrypts and then `JSON.parse`s `reqBody.keys` and persists it directly to `credential.key` (update/create) without any per-app/schema validation of the decrypted payload. Both `symmetricDecrypt(...)` and `JSON.parse(...)` can throw on bad ciphertext/invalid JSON and there is no try/catch, so these failures will bubble as unhandled 500s.
